rationale: §2.3.3 Methods: "participants were asked to complete a short four question form on the training, use of the technology and their overall enjoyment"; no named multi-item motivation instrument and no motivation scores by arm (only enjoyment and interview themes). Posted 2025 preprint.
doubt: I2: allocation was "a partially randomised trial (PRT)" in which participants with stronger rejection of the technology or discomfort "were allocated to the control group"; unclear whether this is random allocation with a minority reassigned (A3) or allocation by participant preference (E2). Not decided here because E5 applies regardless.

rationale: §2.1 Study design: "Secondary outcomes included performance metrics, fear of movement, and the severity of perceived ankle instability" (side-hop test, TSK-11, CAIT); no motivation instrument measured. Randomized Wii Fit exergaming vs balance training, 12 sessions over 4 weeks.
